questions.stem: A 75-year-old man was found on ophthalmoscopic examination to have edema of both optic discs (bilateral papilledema) and congestion of both retinal veins. The cause of the condition was found to be a rapidly expanding intracranial tumor. Which of the following statements is not correct?
questions.stemHtml: A 75-year-old man was found on ophthalmoscopic examination to have edema of both optic discs (bilateral papilledema) and congestion of both retinal veins. The cause of the condition was found to be a rapidly expanding intracranial tumor. Which of the following statements is not correct?

options.label: A
options.text: The Optic Nerves are surrounded by Sheaths derived from the Pia Mater, Arachnoid Mater, and Dura Mater

options.label: B
options.text: The Intracranial Subarachnoid space extends forward around the Optic Nerve as far as the back of the Eyeball.

options.label: C
options.text: The Ciliary Ganglion is situated between the proximal part of Medial Rectus and Optic Nerve

options.label: D
options.text: The Nerve to Medial Rectus is seen Inferior to the Optic Nerve
